raw_response:
This plot is very small and it is one I manage closely with other crops mixed in, so I will rely mostly on family work and what I already have at home. Chemical fertilizer is costly and often late, so on this perennial/fruit plot I would rather use manure or compost and keep cash expenses low. I do not expect to irrigate, and I would not hire labor for such a small piece.
